signature_matches.name: hash data with CRC32
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: hash data with CRC32
    namespace: data-manipulation/checksum/crc32
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: unsupported  # requires operand[1].number, characteristic, bytes, mnemonic features
    mbc:
      - Data::Checksum::CRC32 [C0032.001]
    examples:
      - 2D3EDC218A90F03089CC01715A9F047F:0x403CBD
      - 7D28CB106CB54876B2A5C111724A07CD:0x402350  # RtlComputeCrc32
      - 7EFF498DE13CC734262F87E6B3EF38AB:0x100084A6
  features:
    - or:
      - and:
        - number: 1 = bits in a byte
        - instruction:
          - description: is bit set?
          - or:
            - mnemonic: and
            - mnemonic: test
          - operand[1].number: 1
        - instruction:
          - mnemonic: shr
          - number: 1
        - characteristic: nzxor
        - operand[1].number: 0xEDB88320
      - and:
        - number: 0x8320
        - number: 0xEDB8
        - characteristic: nzxor
      - api: RtlComputeCrc32
      - bytes: 00 00 00 00 96 30 07 77 2C 61 0E EE BA 51 09 99 19 C4 6D 07 8F F4 6A 70 35 A5 63 E9 A3 95 64 9E = crc32_tab

signature_matches.name: complete processing asynchronous IO request
signature_matches.description: host-interaction/driver : signals that driver has finished all processing for a given IRP (part of major function)
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: complete processing asynchronous IO request
    namespace: host-interaction/driver
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    description: signals that driver has finished all processing for a given IRP (part of major function)
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: span of calls
    examples:
      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 10-03.sys_:0x10666
  features:
    - or:
      - api: IoCompleteRequest
      - api: IofCompleteRequest

signature_matches.name: resolve function by parsing PE exports
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: resolve function by parsing PE exports
    namespace: load-code/pe
    authors:
      - sara-rn
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: unsupported  # requires characteristic, offset, mnemonic features
    examples:
      - 73CE04892E5F39EC82B00C02FC04C70F:0x406BA1
  features:
    - and:
      - os: windows
      - or:
        - characteristic: loop
        - mnemonic: movzx
      - and:
        - offset: 0x3C = IMAGE_DOS_HEADER.PE.e_lfanew
        - or:
          - and:
            - arch: i386
            - offset: 0x78 = offset to IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT]
          - and:
            - arch: amd64
            - offset: 0x88 = offset to IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT]
        - 3 or more:
          - offset: 0x14 = IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY.NumberOfFunctions
          - offset: 0x24 = IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY.AddressOfNameOrdinals
          - offset: 0x20 = IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY.AddressOfNames
          - offset: 0x18 = IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY.NumberOfNames
          - offset: 0x1C = IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY.AddressOfFunctions
      - optional:
        - or:
          - api: LoadLibrary
          - api: strcmp
